content.short: Zero-markup intent network for swapping and paying across chains, stablecoins and bank rails.
content.description: orda lets solvers compete to fill money movement orders, from stablecoin swaps to fiat payouts, so spreads are set by competition rather than a markup. Businesses can use its API and SDKs, drop in a widget, or send and receive through a no-code dashboard. It describes itself as the first intent network that can settle in fiat as well as crypto.
content.meta: orda's zero-markup intent network routes stablecoin swaps, ramps and global payouts through competing solvers.
